fato_historico: 1980: The Chun Doo-hwan government forcibly arrests and investigates monks and personnel of the Jogye Order.
energia_do_dia: Today, your intensity may surface as a catalyst for growth. Much like the quiet resilience found in ancient traditions that endure through adversity, you are invited to protect your spiritual integrity. It is a good time to transform past obstacles into wisdom, allowing your natural depth to guide you toward a more harmonious and enlightened path.
frase_do_dia: Your inner light is a fortress that no shadow can ever truly dim.
significado_numero: Represents the bridge between intense intuition and profound emotional healing.
conselho: Stand firm in your truth while remaining open to the beauty of change.
